environment.description: Identical application deployment but with AWS WAFv2 WebACL associated to the ALB. The WebACL contains two rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 100: AWS Managed Rule Group 'AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet' with all rules in COUNT mode except JavaDeserializationRCE which is in BLOCK mode. (2) Priority 200: A custom rule group 'corp-query-inspection' containing a single rule with a RegexPatternSet match on query string values using pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*or\s+'|'\s*--)|(?:\b(?:sleep|benchmark|waitfor)\s*\()` with action BLOCK, applied to all URI paths matching `/api/*`. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm the custom rule fires on test payloads containing UNION SELECT and single-quote-based tautologies. Additionally, the ALB access logs are shipped to S3 with a 5-minute delivery interval.
